{{Quote|If we can get the Ansionians to commit to pulling out of the Republic, no one will really care. But because of their alliances, their withdrawal should be enough to sway their already vacillating partners in both the Malarian Alliance and the Keitumite Treaty to follow.|Presidente Shu Mai|<ref name="Approaching">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>}}
The '''Mondress system''' was an [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], it was visited by the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' on its shakedown cruise. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], the Mondress system was affiliated via the [[Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty]] to seven other [[Star/Legends|star]] systems. That alliance was part of a larger network of forty systems linked by various alliances and treaties to each other, centered on the inconspicuous [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]].

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], when members of the Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty were considering seceding from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of the Independent Systems]] sought to facilitate the secession of the entire network of systems affiliated with Ansion. The Separatist plans were foiled by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|mission to Ansion]], which resulted in the planet and its partner systems remaining loyal to the Republic. [[12 ABY/Legends|Decades later]], the Mondress system was a part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Description==
The Mondress [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located in the [[Mondress sector/Legends|Mondress sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]]<ref name="Outer" /> sub-region<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was connected by a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Horob system/Legends|Horob system]] of the [[Vardoss sector/Legends|Vardoss sector]] as well as the [[Carvandir system/Legends|Carvandir system]] in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Carvandir sector/Legends|same name]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==History==
===A member of the Republic===
{{Quote|The Malarian Alliance. On the face of it, one of hundreds of such casual alliances. Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty. Never invoked, but still in force. Now, observe this.|Presidente Shu Mai, before displaying the network of star systems politically connected to Ansion|<ref name="Approaching" />}}
[[File:MondressOutboundFlight-TEA.png|thumb|left|230px|The ''Outbound Flight'' visited the Mondress system in 27 BBY.]]
The ''[[Outbound Flight]]'',<ref name="TEA" /> a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] on a [[Outbound Flight Project|mission]] to [[Scout/Legends|explore]] and [[Colonist/Legends|colonize]] the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]],<ref name="Outbound">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> visited the Mondress system<ref name="TEA" /> as part of a three-[[Standard week/Legends|week]]-long shakedown cruise<ref name="Outbound" /> in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]]. The meandering route of the tour was carefully [[Star map/Legends|mapped out]] to visit the home sectors of the most important backers of the Outbound Flight Project in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the Republic.<ref name="TEA" />

[[22 BBY/Legends|Five years]] later,<ref name="22 BBY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'', during which the [[Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty]] is in effect, to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the Mondress system was both a member of the Republic and a signatory of<ref name="TEA" /> the never-invoked<ref name="Approaching" /> [[Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty]], the latter of which placed it in a web of mutual affiliations with seven other systems: the [[Dorin system/Legends|Dorin system]] of the Expansion Region's<ref name="TEA" /> [[Deadalis sector/Legends|Deadalis sector]];<ref name="EAOC" /> the [[Eeropha system]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]; and the [[Ansion system/Legends|Ansion]], [[Glom Tho system/Legends|Glom Tho]], [[Keitum system/Legends|Keitum]], [[Lonnaw system/Legends|Lonnaw]], and [[Malari system/Legends|Malari systems]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. In addition, Mondress, its partner systems, and the [[Malarian Alliance]]&mdash;also affiliated with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]&mdash;all had treaties of their own with other worlds, which led to the seemingly insignificant Ansion lying at the center of a network of approximately forty [[Politics/Legends|politically]] connected [[Star/Legends|star]] systems. During the ongoing [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]],<ref name="TEA" /> signatory systems of both the Malarian Alliance and the Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty were individually considering leaving the Republic.<ref name="Approaching" />

===A Separatist plot===
{{Quote|Assuming the internal divisions continue to widen, I would expect a formal vote on whether to withdraw from the Republic within half a standard year.''"<br />"''At which point we can look on with satisfaction as those who have been traditionally allied to Ansion follow suit, and those allied to the allies fall in turn.|Senator Mousul and Shu Mai|<ref name="Approaching" />}}
[[File:Ansion-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Confederacy of Independent Systems intended to use the connections of the planet Ansion to the Mondress system and others for political gain.]]
The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] intended to facilitate the secession of Ansion from the Republic, which was predicted by the Separatists to cause a cascade of secession by all the systems linked to the planet via its treaties, as well.<ref name="TEA" /> [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]]<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|shumai|Mai, Shu}}</ref> [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] explained the Separatist plan to the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] industrialist [[Tam Uliss]] and his [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Unidentified Twi'lek (Tam Uliss)|companion]] during a meeting with Ansion's [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Mousul]] in a private chamber on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Approaching" /> a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet serving as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Republic,<ref name="TEA" /> in 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="22 BBY" /> Mai also singled out the member systems of the Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty,<ref name="Approaching" /> including Mondress,<ref name="TEA" /> for the group in a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] projection of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Approaching" />

However, a [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|mission to Ansion]] undertaken at the [[Time/Legends|time]] by members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on behalf of the Republic resulted in that world<ref name="TEA" /> and its partners remaining loyal to the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] government,<ref name="Approaching" /> foiling the Separatist plans. At some point following the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the newly-appointed Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the Mid Rim's [[Churnis sector/Legends|Churnis sector]] declared all existing treaties and alliances involving Ansion to be null and void.<ref name="TEA" /> The Mondress system fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] by [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Approaching Storm]]'', a [[2002]] novel by [[Alan Dean Foster]], featured a holographic representation of the several unnamed star systems connected to Ansion via the Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty.<ref name="Approaching" /> Drawing upon the name of the Mondress sector, which was originally introduced in the [[1994]] [[West End Games]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'',<ref name="GG10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref> one of those systems was identified as the Mondress system by the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square J-7.<ref name="TEA" />
